defends: Capacity is not skill adjacency. One program manager could in principle hold all three workstreams; it is still three hires at 80-100 engineers across three regions.
source: Statement of work, Aug 2026. Client anonymized; the vendor technology is named because it is the subject matter, not the client.
practitioner_read: Three jobs, defined by the SOW's own workstreams. (Kathleen Bartin, Aug 2026.)
notes: Collapsed to 1 role before the capacity test existed. min is 2 rather than 3 because the LMS strand is genuinely arguable; anything below 2 means the capacity test has stopped working.
